comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Left is 1 if any comment explicitly engages (addresses, questions, rebuts, accepts or builds on) a specific OP example or premise, and the engagement need not be critical. Right is 1 only if a comment argues that the OP's own premises contradict each other or are logically inconsistent. Right is a much narrower critique subtype. Right also explicitly excludes mere disagreement and counterexamples, which Left would count. The null rules differ as well: Left returns null if argument is missing or context is insufficient, while Right returns null only if both title and argument are missing.
